hard_fails.actual: The 'Approve' quick action on every pending roadmap_item row in wp-admin (Roadmap > All Items, Pending filter) is present in the DOM with the correct href/nonce/capability gate but is completely invisible (0x0 box, offsetParent null) due to a CSS class-name collision with WordPress core's own Comments-list-table styling. Root cause: product-roadmap/includes/class-roadmap-cpt.php add_quick_approve_actions() (line 1029) sets $actions['approve'], and WP_List_Table::row_actions() (wp-admin/includes/class-wp-list-table.php:689) wraps every row-action key in <span class="$action">. WordPress core's wp-admin/css/common.css defines an UNSCOPED rule '.approve, .unapproved .unapprove { display: none; }' with '.unapproved .approve, .spam .approve, .trash .approve { display: inline; }' as the only escape - written for the Comments screen where rows carry class unapproved/spam/trash. The Posts list table's pending roadmap_item rows carry class 'status-pending' instead, so core's blanket .approve{display:none} always wins and the Approve link never becomes visible, for any user, on any page load. Confirmed 100% reproducible on 3 independent pending items across 2 personas (qa_elevated, qa_admin). The backend handler itself is correct: navigating directly to the same href (bypassing the CSS) moved the post from pending to publish exactly as expected, so this is a pure dead-UI bug, not a broken handler. Reject is unaffected (different, non-colliding key name) and works correctly with its two-step no-native-dialog confirm.

top3: Both hard fails from the previous run are confirmed fixed and hold under regression testing: members can now edit/delete only their own submitted items via REST (other members still get 403, no privilege-escalation regression), and Pro's init() fires correctly so the invalid-license admin notice and Pro's translation loading both work again. D.13's changelog slug bug is also reconfirmed fixed via a real block-editor publish (gamma-api-v2-5-0, not general-...).

New blocker found this run: the 'Approve' quick action on every pending suggestion in wp-admin (Roadmap > All Items > Pending) is invisible to every user because its row-action key 'approve' collides with an unscoped WordPress core CSS rule written for the Comments screen. The backend handler works fine when hit directly; the one-click UI moderators are supposed to use is a dead end. Workaround exists (Quick Edit -> Status -> Published, or open-and-publish) but the documented single-click action does not work as shipped.

Everything else exercised this pass came back clean: fresh-install routes/DB schema, member suggest/vote/comment flow (incl. rate-limit content preservation - D.8), mobile 390px board layout, admin Settings/Dashboard/Analytics/Setup-Wizard (D.14's notice suppression holds), Pro merge-duplicates (votes+comments transplanted, source trashed), analytics vote count matching the votes table exactly, deleted-product board handling (D.6), timeline.js correctly withheld when disabled (D.18), two-step no-native-dialog confirm on Reject (D.11), and the Pro .pot file (D.17). Large swaths were not exercised this run for time/environment reasons - see untested[] - most notably B-upgrade, full RTL/dark-mode sweeps, multisite, Firefox/Safari, and several Pro-only features (webhooks, digest emails, custom fields, feedback widget, email templates, user profiles).

failures.triage_note: Root-caused via live DOM inspection: span.approve computed display:none, traced to wp-admin/css/common.css's unscoped '.approve{display:none}' rule (written for #the-comment-list, not scoped there). product-roadmap's add_quick_approve_actions() (class-roadmap-cpt.php:1029) uses the bare array key 'approve', which WP_List_Table::row_actions() turns into <span class="approve">, colliding with core's global selector on the Posts list table. Reproduced on 3 separate pending items (posts 1084, 1085, 1321/1325 fixtures) across qa_elevated and qa_admin - not user- or data-specific. Confirmed the handler itself is correct by navigating directly to the (invisible) link's href: post 1321 moved from pending to publish exactly as intended. Fix direction (not applied, verification-only run): rename the row-action array key to something plugin-scoped, e.g. 'roadmap_approve', so it no longer collides with WordPress's reserved '.approve' class.
failures.expected: An editor/admin viewing Roadmap > All Items > Pending sees both 'Approve' (green) and 'Reject' (red) quick-action links in each row's row-actions strip, per card 10344407804's dialog-free flow.
failures.actual: Only 'Reject' is visible. 'Approve' exists in the DOM (correct href/nonce) but renders at 0x0 with offsetParent null because of the .approve CSS collision described above.
